text:
Elaine: Customer (org-9123) reports sudden jump in latencies and 503s. They expect traffic pinned to us-east but traces show lots of hits to eu-west. Billing flagged extra egress charges. Anyone seen this today?
Sam: Can you drop the request-id / example curl from the customer? Also which API token/org header they used.
Elaine: Pasted from their ticket: `curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-prod-REDACTED" -H "X-Redwood-Org: org-9123" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate` Response headers include `x-routing-region: eu-west-1` and `x-request-id: r-0a7f3c`. They claim sticky routing should keep sessions in us-east after the initial handshake.
Raj: Thanks. Two quick hypotheses: 1) failover policy weight/priority parsing bug after yesterday's routing-config deploy, 2) sticky-affinity key not being applied (hashing mismatch).
Maria: Deploy bot shows routing-config v2026-02-15 rolled out at 06:12 UTC. Might be our change that allowed decimal weights as strings. We had a change to accept both ints and strings in policy YAML.
deploy-bot: routing-config v2026-02-15 deployed to control-plane (canary 10% -> 100%).
Sam: Can we reproduce locally? I'll run an org-scoped routing decision query.
Sam: repro command: `curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -H "X-Redwood-Org: org-9123" https://internal-api.redwood.local/v1/routing/decision?path=/v1/generate -v`
Sam: sample output shows: `x-routing-region: eu-west-1` and log line: `RTR_DECISION id=r-0a7f3c chosen_region=eu-west-1 reason=weight_score:0.72 (eu-west) priority:1`
Raj: Can you paste the customer's failover policy? They might have weights and priority inverted.
Elaine: Customer policy (redacted):
```
failover_policy:
  - region: us-east-1
    priority: 2
    weight: "0.9"
  - region: eu-west-1
    priority: 1
    weight: "0.1"
sticky: true
```
Sam: Aha. Two things: priority=1 is higher than priority=2 in our runtime (lower number = higher priority), and weights are strings. If the parser stored weights as strings we might be doing lexicographic comparisons or casting surprises. That combination could pick eu-west despite intended preference.
Maria: Confirmed in logs: our policy loader coerces weight to string when the YAML uses quotes, then downstream score calc does `parseFloat(weight) || fallback` but an earlier patch accidentally switched to a string comparison in the quick path causing priority-based short-circuit to mis-evaluate. Created a quick grep: `git blame` points to the decimal-weight change.
Raj: Immediate mitigation: update customer's policy to set explicit priority order (1 for us-east), and remove quotes from weights (use numeric). Quick fix command for support to apply (internal tool): `support-cli update-policy --org org-9123 --file policy_fixed.yaml`
Elaine: Ran the fix as `policy_fixed.yaml` with priority swapped and numeric weights.
Sam: After change, routing decision log for same request id: `RTR_DECISION id=r-0a7f3c chosen_region=us-east-1 reason=priority_rule:match sticky=true`
Elaine: Customer confirms lower latency now, 95p dropped from ~420ms -> ~70ms, and 503s stopped. Billing team: can we refund cross-region egress for the spike?
BillingBot: Noted ticket FIN-2331, flagged for review. Please include exact timestamps and prefixes.
Raj: Root cause: config parsing accepts quoted weights; a recent change introduced a string-vs-number edge-case where priority evaluation and weight fallback interacted incorrectly. Sticky affinity was fine — it wasn't used because the routing decision picked eu-west based on mis-evaluated policy.
Maria: Plan: 1) rollback the quick parsing change on control-plane (hotfix) 2) add unit tests for quoted numeric weights 3) ship a safe parser that normalizes types during validation 4) run a migration to normalize stored policies. Canary rollout 10% -> 100% with 30m observation window.
Raj: I've opened infra PR #2847 with the hotfix. Will push canary at 18:30 UTC.
Sam: Will monitor routing metrics for org-9123 and cluster-level region churn.
Elaine: Customer updated ticket saying they're unblocked and appreciate the quick turnaround.
Maria: After canary completed, saw no regressions. Metrics returned to baseline for the org.
Elaine: Closing support ticket and notifying customer. Marking incident as resolved. :white_check_mark:
Raj: Follow-ups: add migration script, billing refund action item assigned to BillingBot FIN-2331, and postmortem to be scheduled.
BillingBot: FIN-2331 assigned to @BillingOps.
Elaine: Thanks team. Good catch on the parsing edge-case.
